'''Pokémon Adventures: Shadowboxing Gengar''' is the thirty-fifth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters thirty-five, thirty-six, and thirty-seven of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|6}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

==Important events==
* [[Lt. Surge]] and {{adv|Bill}} defeat [[Bruno]].
* {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} wakes up after being controlled by a {{p|Gastly}}.
* [[Agatha]] has a flashback of her battling {{adv|Professor Oak}}, revealing her motivations for considering him an enemy, and Oak's own ambitions in creating the [[Pokédex]].
* {{adv|Blue}} and [[Koga]] try to get out of Agatha's maze.
* Blue and Koga are attacked by [[Agatha's Gengar]].
* The Elite Four's Pokémon land in the remaining [[Kanto]] cities.
